description: Fetch one or more random Wikipedia articles from a language edition. Returns article titles, page IDs, and URLs. Supports any valid MediaWiki language code and up to 500 results per request. No login required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of random articles to return (1-500, default 1).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language edition code (default zh). Common values: zh / en / ja / ko / fr / de / es / ru. Any valid MediaWiki language code works.
